scripts.install-all: concurrently "npm run install-root" "npm run install-frontend" "npm run install-backend"
scripts.build: concurrently "cd frontend && npm run build" "npm run install-frontend" "npm run install-backend"
scripts.build:prod: npm run install-root && npm run install-frontend && npm run install-backend && npm run build-frontend
scripts.mobile: concurrently "npm run start-backend" "cd frontend && npx cross-env VITE_HOST=0.0.0.0 VITE_PORT=3000 vite dev --host"
